config_description: NER extractor + exact/fuzzy ESCO lexicon matching; embedding ranking removed
interpretation: Removing embedding ranking reduces ESCO linking performance while extraction remains unchanged.

config_description: Baseline 2 noun-phrase spans + full exact/fuzzy and embedding ESCO ranker; NER removed
interpretation: The reviewed-gold linking scores are expected to equal the full pipeline because both use the same ranker on the same reviewed spans. The end-to-end coverage isolates the effect of replacing NER with Baseline 2 noun-phrase spans.

config_description: Domain transfer of the SKILLSPAN-trained NER model
interpretation: The gold-standard corpus is out-of-distribution relative to SKILLSPAN. A positive gap indicates degradation on the collected job-posting corpus; a zero gap indicates no change.

config_description: Replace all-mpnet-base-v2 with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 in the ESCO ranker
interpretation: Positive deltas indicate that MiniLM outperformed MPNet; negative deltas indicate a decrease. Both models were loaded from local SentenceTransformer snapshots and evaluated on the same 601 reviewed spans with the same lexicon-first ranking procedure. FAISS was unavailable on this macOS host, so both models use the mathematically equivalent NumPy exact inner-product index.
